It is a commitment founded upon faith, compassion, responsibility, trust and mutual respect.
It is not simply about finding someone you love or planning a beautiful wedding.
A wedding may last a day, but the responsibilities of marriage can last a lifetime.
This is why we have developed the LifeLink Marriage Academy. Across our 18 compulsory modules, we will explore the foundations of a success…
Across our 18 compulsory modules, we will explore the foundations of a successful marriage, from choosing a compatible partner and understa…
choosing a compatible partner and understanding Islamic responsibilities to communication, managing conflict, finances, family relationship…
Our aim is not simply to help you prepare for marriage, but to equip you with the tools to build a healthy, respectful and lasting relation…
In this first module, we will explore the sacred purpose of marriage and what it means to enter this partnership with the right intentions …
As you listen, I encourage you to reflect not only on the qualities you want in a future spouse, but also on the qualities you are bringing…
Before we explore the foundations of marriage, I would like to explain what we will be learning throughout this module.
Our journey begins with understanding the divine purpose of marriage.
We will look at why marriage holds such an important position in Islam and how it can contribute to our spiritual and personal development.
We will then explore what I call the marital ecosystem. Marriage does not exist in isolation.
It affects our emotional well-being, family relationships, financial circumstances, spiritual development and wider responsibilities.
Next, we will consider the concept of partnership and a manner of sacred trust.
What does it actually mean to share your life with another individual?
How do we balance our own needs and ambitions with the needs of someone else?
We will also examine the qualities of a successful marriage.
Often when people are searching for a spouse, they focus on external qualities such as appearance, education, employment, family background…
Although some of these considerations may be important, we must also look at the emotional maturity and the ability to communicate.
We will then explore realistic expectations.
Many relationships experience difficulties because individuals enter marriage with assumptions that have never been discussed.
Finally, we will complete what we call the mirror check.
This is an opportunity to look inward and reflect on our own readiness for marriage.
Throughout this module, remember that the aim is not perfection. None of us are perfect and marriage does not require us to become perfect …
However, it does require us to recognise our responsibilities, understand our strengths and identify areas in which we need to grow.
Beautiful descriptions of marriage in the Quran appears in Surah Arghum, verse 21.

It means feeling emotionally secure, knowing that you can express your thoughts without fear or humiliation and trusting that your spouse w…

The second pillar is mawuddha or affection. Affection is more than simply telling someone that you love them. It is demonstrated through ev…
A kind word, a thoughtful gesture, showing appreciation, spending meaningful time together or offering support after a difficult day. These…

There will be times when one spouse is tired, unwell, worried or struggling. During these moments compassion and understanding can make an …

Now consider these three qualities together. Tranquility provides emotional security. If affection builds connection, mercy helps sustain t…

but it also provides opportunities for companionship, emotional connection and spiritual growth.

Having someone to share experiences with, celebrate achievements with and turning to during difficult times can be a valuable part of marri…

Living closely with another person can teach us patience, generosity, gratitude, compromise and self-reflection.

A couple must make decisions about finances, accommodation, family relationships, household responsibilities and their future.
These responsibilities require communication and cooperation.

Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, thought that the best amongst us are those who are best to their wives.

Sometimes individuals are highly respected within their communities. They may be known for their religious knowledge, professional achievem…

It is relatively easy to show patience and kindness when everything is going well.
The greater challenge is maintaining those qualities when we are tired, frustrated, disappointed or under pressure.
Consider this example. Someone may speak politely to colleagues throughout the working day but return home and speak harshly to their spous…
